title: 第一卷 第3章 你也不想你和大夫人的事情被别人知道吧第一卷 第4章 我真的来不起了
lines: 陈玄很清楚，自己回答会的时候，肯定是会驳了赵凇的面子。
但是，有了刚才的事情，赵凇后面肯定不会放过他了，作为后厨的学徒，陈玄在将军府之中，都是最底层的下人。
他真被赵凇弄死，估计都没有人会在意！
在陈玄的记忆之中，来到将军府这一个月，赵凇从来没有教他任何有用的技能，他的工作就是当墩子，切菜！
将军府几百号人的菜，由他们几个人切出来，几乎是从早忙到晚，等到切完的时候，也累得只想睡觉了。
如果继续呆在后厨，他感觉自己会烂死在这个地方。
包括三天之后去见林婉！
虽然陈玄也垂涎于林婉的美色，但是他不想拿自己的命去赌。
林婉是找他双修，他这身体肯定顶不住，毕竟上一个陈玄，已经死了！
而白浅浅出现在这个地方专门来寻找他，只有一个可能，那就是因为昨晚自己去了林婉的院子！
而她来的目的，陈玄琢磨着，大概率是为了争权。
将军府伴随着镇国大将军的死亡，将军府的大量权利，都握在了林婉的手上，而林婉和自己的事情如果被白浅浅所知道，这便是他的把柄。
当然，陈玄很清楚一点的是，自己一旦真的卷入这样的争斗之中，大概率就是炮灰！
不论之后白浅浅给他什么条件，他都不会提及昨天晚上的任何一个字。
但是他也有着赌的资本，那就是他现代人的厨艺！
根据陈玄的记忆来看，这个世界的美食很一般，几乎是美食荒漠。
如果自己做几个菜做好了，抓住了白浅浅的胃，或许，就能够破局，甚至还能找机会报复赵凇！
当然，如果赌错了，他的麻烦，可能会更大！鬼知道到时候赵凇会怎么对付他。
“既然会去做，那便去吧，让我看看你的手艺。”白浅浅说着，找了把椅子坐了下来！
陈玄吐了一口气，他看了看旁边的赵凇，赵凇的眼神仿佛想要杀人一般。
不过陈玄却自动过滤了，既然决定赌这一把，他就预想到了这个后果。
他来到后厨，仔细看了一下，后厨食材不少。虽然调味料什么的，不如现代来得那么齐全，但是做几个家常菜，也差不多了！
他简单的扫了一下，而后便开始迅速的动手！
片刻之后，后厨内便有着一阵的香味传出。
“咦？”赵凇神色一动。
他刚才之所以想要杀人，一是陈玄驳了他的面子，二是他认为陈玄偷师了。
但是当陈玄开始做菜的时候，他发现陈玄做菜的方式和他预想的完全不一样。
陈玄一边做，他不时偷偷的看了几眼白浅浅，让他无奈的是，白浅浅一直都在盯着他，即便他的目光看过去，白浅浅也毫不避让。
陈玄只好低头开始做了起来。
这个世界的吃的，主要还是以蒸煮为主，炒菜并没有普及。
而此时陈玄做的，就是正常的家常小炒。
大概半个时辰之后，陈玄便炒好了三个菜，就在他打算继续动作的时候，白浅浅便开口道：“差不多了，装盒，跟我走吧！”
陈玄擦了擦额头上的汗，然后他取出一个食盒，将碟子装在了盒子里面！
“小红，走！”白浅浅起身，其旁边，一个婢女连忙扶着她的手，朝着后厨外走去！

Chen Xuan knew very well that when he answered yes, he would definitely refute Zhao Song's face.
However, after what happened just now, Zhao Song will definitely not let him go. As an apprentice of the chef, Chen Xuan is the lowest servant in the general's mansion.
If he was really killed by Zhao Song, no one would care!
In Chen Xuan's memory, during the month he came to the General's Mansion, Zhao Song never taught him any useful skills. His job was to be a butler and chop vegetables!
A few of them cut the dishes for hundreds of people in the General's Mansion. They were busy almost from morning to night. By the time they finished cutting, they were so tired that they just wanted to sleep.
If he continued to stay in the kitchen, he felt like he would rot and die in this place.
Including meeting Lin Wan in three days!
Although Chen Xuan also coveted Lin Wan's beauty, he didn't want to risk his life.
Lin Wan was looking for him to practice dual cultivation. His body would definitely not be able to withstand it. After all, the last Chen Xuan was already dead!
There is only one possibility for Bai Qianqian to appear here specifically to look for him, and that is because she went to Lin Wan's yard last night!
As for the purpose of her coming, Chen Xuan thought, it was most likely to fight for power.
With the death of General Zhenguo, a lot of the power of the General's Palace was in Lin Wan's hands, and if Bai Qianqian knew about Lin Wan and herself, this would be his leverage.
Of course, Chen Xuan knows very well that once he is really involved in such a fight, he will most likely become cannon fodder!
No matter what conditions Bai Qianqian gave him in the future, he would never mention a single word about last night.
But he also has gambling capital, and that is his modern cooking skills!
According to Chen Xuan's memory, the food in this world is very average, almost a food desert.
If he cooks a few dishes and catches Bai Qianqian's stomach, maybe he can break the situation and even find a chance to take revenge on Zhao Song!
Of course, if the bet is wrong, his troubles may be even greater! Who knows how Zhao Song will deal with him then.
"Since you can do it, then go ahead and let me see your craftsmanship." Bai Qianqian said, finding a chair and sitting down!
Chen Xuan let out a breath and looked at Zhao Song next to him. Zhao Song's eyes seemed to want to kill someone.
However, Chen Xuan automatically filtered it. Since he decided to take the gamble, he had anticipated the consequences.
He came to the kitchen and took a closer look. There were a lot of ingredients in the kitchen. Although the seasonings are not as complete as modern ones, it is almost enough to make a few home-cooked dishes!
He briefly scanned it, and then started to act quickly!
After a while, there was a burst of fragrance coming from the kitchen.
"Huh?" Zhao Song's expression changed.
The reason why he wanted to kill someone just now was because, firstly, Chen Xuan refuted his face, and secondly, he thought that Chen Xuan had stolen his master.
But when Chen Xuan started cooking, he found that the way Chen Xuan cooked was completely different from what he expected.
While Chen Xuan was doing this, he secretly glanced at Bai Qianqian from time to time. What made him helpless was that Bai Qianqian was always staring at him. Even if he looked over, Bai Qianqian would not look away.
Chen Xuan had no choice but to lower his head and start working.
Food in this world is mainly based on steaming and cooking, and stir-frying has not become popular.
At this time, what Chen Xuan was doing was normal home-cooked stir-fry.
About half an hour later, Chen Xuan had fried three dishes. Just when he was about to continue, Bai Qianqian said: "It's almost done. Pack it up and come with me!"
Chen Xuan wiped the sweat from his forehead, then he took out a food box and put the dishes in the box!
"Xiaohong, let's go!" Bai Qianqian stood up. Next to her, a maidservant quickly held her hand and walked out of the kitchen!
